PluginData.Author: GyverX
PluginData.Tooltip: Client-side recolorable, movable planetary compass + clock.
PluginData.Description:
A clean, configurable planetary compass and clock drawn straight onto the HUD.
- Client-side only: works on any server, no world mod and no Text HUD API required. - Recolor the text, move and resize it, with a tinted backing plate so it stays readable. - Cardinal letters or degrees, optional UTC + Local clock, live settings dialog.
Configure it in the plugin's settings screen. Purely visual — it never affects the world or other players.
